scope: Read-only investigation of already-recorded owned CEF sample and pinned official sources; reviewer did not execute CEF, inspect Keychain contents, or change global settings.

observed: Main thread is waiting within stripped CEF framework in all 863 samples (lines 24-39). Export-nearest symbol labels do not identify internal function names.

ThreadPoolForegroundWorker 11547382 is within SecItemCopyMatching -> SecKeychainItemCopyContent -> SecurityServer::ClientSession::decrypt -> mach_msg in all 863 samples (lines 234-267). This is real OS Keychain access, not merely a timing assertion.
Chrome_IO thread is absent and Shutdown watchdog thread is present (line 514).
Parent/host lifecycle diagnostics report OnBeforeClose, message loop return, consumer join/report and shutdown_enter; no shutdown_return. The close-once variant still timed out.

inference.confidence: strong hypothesis, not symbolicated causal proof
inference.hypothesis: A running OSCrypt Keychain provider task waits on macOS Keychain IPC and prevents ThreadPool shutdown. Its waiting semantics and the absence of Chrome_IO match the pinned shutdown ordering.
not_established: Exact encrypted item or password queried by the observed process.
Whether Keychain data were returned, changed, exposed or exported.
Whether a user prompt existed or how it was answered.
Successful native closure or sandbox behavior.

security_finding: The owned fixture reached the real OS Keychain despite using a private Chromium profile/root_cache_path. Profile isolation alone does not isolate native OS services. Preserve this observed boundary finding independently of eventual closure success.

mitigation_candidate.application: Compile fixture-only switch in trusted CefApp::OnBeforeCommandLineProcessing before initialization, using existing command-line policy; no user-provided flags, credentials, Keychain inspection, global preferences or security policy changes.
mitigation_candidate.mechanism: Pinned provider selects a per-task in-memory FakeKeychainV2.
limits: This is a fixture/test backend, not a sandbox or production credential policy.
The switch applies to this OSCrypt provider path; it does not prove all potential native Keychain accesses are suppressed.
No sandbox disabling flag is needed or proposed.
Runtime result must be recorded by the authorized host run separately.
Do not promote this evidence to Production/native acceptance PASS.

cef_sources.claim: CefShutdown calls context shutdown on the initialization thread; UI shutdown destroys browsers and finalization releases CEF app references.
Single-thread shutdown invokes browser_runner shutdown then content shutdown. Quit closure is consumed once; repeat-quit hypothesis is not supported by the new failed close-once run.
Official example keeps an application CefRefPtr and Objective-C delegate alive across CefShutdown, so their presence alone is not evidence of a leak/deadlock.

chromium_sources.claim: Defines use-mock-keychain for tests to prevent blocking dialogs/timeouts.
The worker chooses per-task FakeKeychainV2 when the flag is present; otherwise real KeychainV2. It is posted USER_BLOCKING and MayBlock with default shutdown behavior.

Unbranded default service is Chromium Safe Storage, account Chromium. GetPassword calls FindGenericPassword; missing item can lead to an add. These defaults do not establish which item the sampled process accessed.
FakeKeychainV2 FindGenericPassword returns its in-memory mock password/result.
Default TaskTraits shutdown behavior is SKIP_ON_SHUTDOWN; already-running tasks can block shutdown.
Running SKIP_ON_SHUTDOWN tasks count as shutdown blockers. CompleteShutdown waits for the shutdown event.
Browser shutdown stops IO before waiting on ThreadPoolInstance::Shutdown.
macOS installs KeychainKeyProvider when the feature is enabled and starts async provider initialization.

independent_bridge_review.finding: The initial native dispatcher checked expires_ms against sender-provided admission time and passed that old timestamp to JS. IPC delayed past TTL could therefore still be delivered.
independent_bridge_review.host_proposed_fix: Pass trusted common steady-clock origin in immutable CreateBrowser extra_info. Renderer computes its own arrival time relative to that origin, checks sender time <= arrival and deadline against arrival, then passes arrival to JS. Add delayed-IPC pure test. Binding starts lifecycle at 0, so simply supplying absolute time would be incorrect.
independent_bridge_review.verification_limit: Correction and native execution require separate host evidence; this research file records no native PASS. Existing port-adapter/runtime and final DOM provenance were not modified.
